verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's security page documents some protections. On the physical side, unwanted mail is shredded on-site with destruction certificates, and customers can opt out of opening or scanning. On the digital side, accounts are protected with 2FA, and the company will sign a HIPAA BAA. None of the story's named elements is documented. Missing for 10: facility access controls, staff background screening, encryption of scans at rest or in transit, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, the provider documents how mail is physically secured and digitally protected — facility controls, staff screening, encryption of scans
